entities.summary: Bundoran is a town in County Donegal, Ireland. The town includes the townland of Magheracar, in which was located Bundrowes, a Franciscan house that served as the principal base of Mícheál Ó Cléirigh during the compilation of the Annals of the Four Masters in the 1630s.
